raw_definitions: Definisi : n person esp a woman who has never had sex, (anak) dara. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : 6. ( of clay ) not fired, asal; 7. ( of metal ) made from ore by smelting, murni; 8. ( of wool ) not chemically processed, murni; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : adj 1. pure and chaste, dara, perawan; 2. befitting a virgin, spt seorang /dara, perawan/: ~ modesty, kesopanan spt seorang dara; 3. pure and untouched, murni: the ~ snow, salji murni; 4. ( of soil ) unused, asal; 5. ( of forest ) in the natural state, dara; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
